title: Crosswalks to the NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) | NIST

policy_extraction.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
covered_actors: Organizations designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems (AI actors)

evidence.quote:
the goal of the AI RMF is to offer a
voluntary
resource to the organizations designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems to help manage the many risks of AI and promote trustworthy and responsible development and use of AI systems.

The Framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector specific, and use-case agnostic, providing flexibility to organizations of all sizes and in all sectors and throughout society to implement the approaches in the Framework.

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Companion NIST webpage introducing crosswalks mapping AI RMF 1.0 to external AI standards and governance frameworks. Reaffirms the AI RMF's voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector-specific, and use-case-agnostic design under P.L. 116-283 and invites public comments on crosswalks.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: This brief companion page is dominantly framed around innovation_enablement, emphasizing a voluntary, flexible, non-sector-specific, internationally aligned standards resource designed to equip AI actors to increase system trustworthiness without prescriptive mandates. Innovation_enablement edges out fundamental_rights (signaled explicitly by 'rights-preserving') and consumer_public_safety (managing the many risks of AI to promote responsible use), both of which appear as concise supporting rationales.

evidence_spans.quote: The Framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector specific, and use-case agnostic, providing flexibility to organizations of all sizes and in all sectors and throughout society to implement the approaches in the Framework.
The Framework is intended for use with, and to encourage the development of other AI resources, including guidance and standards.
